policy.description: Execution-time policy for a customer-service refund saga. Amounts use integer minor currency units.
runtime_invariants: Every MCP tools/call carries a short-lived signed Action Passport.
The passport binds tenant, agent, workflow, tool, resource, exact arguments, budget, policy and approval.
A new idempotency key cannot reuse an exhausted passport.
Refund balance changes and refund records commit atomically.
A failed downstream step triggers a separately authorized compensation action.
Completion requires an independent read-back of refund, ticket and order state.

approval.reason: A separately authenticated reviewer checked the frozen evidence, policy, amount, and exact action scope.

trust_model: Trust keys and pinned policy are external verifier inputs; no embedded root is trusted.
